name: tide_front_v2
description: A single vertical curved WATER wave front shaped like a closing parenthesis ) and moving RIGHT. The entire LEFT side is OPEN, no closed circle, no torus, no portal, no ring, no hole. Top and bottom sharp water tips curve back to LEFT. Thin white-mint foam cutting edge along RIGHT contour, thick cyan water just behind edge and a few droplets trailing left. Like a bow WITHOUT any string. Upright height 50px, thickness 16px, centered. Pixel-art action-RPG projectile, crisp deliberate clusters, aqua slime turquoise palette, dark teal selective outline. Transparent background, no objects or characters or ground, no blur.

name: guard_membrane_v2
description: Two SEPARATE small curved gold and dark teal liquid armor scales, one floating at far left, one at far right, facing inward. Broad EMPTY SPACE between them occupies central 36px square and is fully transparent. Only two isolated strips near canvas left and right edges with a couple tiny golden glints. Not a shield object, not a circle, no connecting surface, no glass, no disc, no body, no filled center, no background. Pixel-art game overlay, restrained muted brass and olive gold, dark teal edges, crisp pixel clusters. Each strip 7px wide 26px tall, arranged symmetrically with lower ends curving slightly inward.

name: spitter_current_v2
description: Four SEPARATE tiny turquoise water jets and bubbles spaced around far left and far right of a transparent 64px canvas. Wide empty center 36px square completely transparent. Each jet is a 10px curved mint-cyan stroke with two separate trailing teal beads. Only sparse liquid fragments; not a circular ring, not an orb, no central fill, no glass, no sphere, no character, no arrows, no magic disc, no text. Sharp hand-clustered game pixel-art effect overlay. Dark teal selective outline and pale mint cutting highlights, aqua slime turquoise palette.
